tone.target: bright prog-rock clean crunch with subtle chorus and delay
tone.profile: bright prog-rock clean crunch with subtle chorus and delay
tone.summary: A bright signal chain utilizing a light boost/OD, Chorus, and Digital Delay into a Vox-style clean amp model with a vintage 4x12 cabinet, topped off with Spring Reverb.

rig.name: Gentle Giant - Free Hand - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide light, articulate overdrive for the 'crunch' element without heavy distortion.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is chosen to emulate a mild Vox-style breakup rather than a pure clean boost.

Bypass: Keep the signal clean and focused on the pre-amp boost.
blocks.gap: The tone requires only light overdrive (Green OD) rather than dedicated distortion.

blocks.purpose: Provide the clean headroom and Vox-style character required for progressive rock.
blocks.gap: The UK SLP is the closest model to a classic, articulate British combo amp sound.

blocks.purpose: Ground the sound in a classic British clean tone and provide necessary frequency response.
Brighten the overall tone and enhance the 'jangly chime' quality.
